  "School Name",
  "County Name",
  "District Name",
  ROUND(CASE
    WHEN "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NULL OR "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"

    a.element

    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 THEN
